usageNotes: Returns the host-level firewall configuration for a specific node, including whether the firewall is enabled, log verbosity for in/out/forwarded traffic, conntrack settings, and DDoS mitigations (synflood, SMURFS, TCP-flag filters). Requires Sys.Audit on /nodes/{node} — readable by API tokens with that privilege. Use this before modifying node firewall options to capture the current state and avoid blind overwrites.

examples.summary: Read firewall options for node pve1

tips: enable defaults to 1 (on) — an absent field in the response means the default is in effect, not that the option is unset.
nftables is a tech preview flag; enabling it changes the firewall backend and may affect existing iptables rules.
nf_conntrack_max defaults to 262144; on busy nodes with many VMs/CTs, a low conntrack limit causes dropped connections — check this when troubleshooting intermittent packet loss.
log_level_in/out/forward all default to 'nolog'; setting them to 'info' or 'debug' generates high syslog volume on active nodes.
